sanskrit: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | kṣayaṃ yadukule yāte bhāre copahṛte bhuvaḥ | prabhāse yādavaśreṣṭhaḥ svasthānamagamaddhariḥ || 9 || dvārāvatyā plāvitāyāṃ samaṃtātsāgareṇa hi | kathaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra kalau daitya prakīrtyate || 10 || kathayasva suraśreṣṭha kathaṃ viṣṇurmahītale | sthitaścānarttaviṣaya etadvistarato vada || 11 ||
english: 9-11. The sages said, “When the Yadu dynasty met with its downfall, then the best of the Yadu, i.e. Kṛṣṇa had rescued the earth from its resultant burden and had then left for his own place, i.e. Prabhāsa. When flooded by sea, Dvārāvat got washed away. So how could God’s name be used to be taken with all glory there in the Kaliyuga? How could Viṣṇu stay back in this region on earth’s surface evoking adoration of people? Tell us in details.”
